Call notes - 2026-08-14, 30 min intro call with founder

Company: Acme Robotics
Sector: Industrial automation
Stage: Seed
Ask: $2M at $10M post

Problem: Warehouses waste roughly 20% of labor hours on manual sorting of
mixed-SKU pallets, and it's the single biggest complaint their design
partners raised in discovery.

Solution: A computer-vision-guided picking arm that retrofits onto existing
conveyor lines without requiring a warehouse redesign.

Traction: 3 paid pilot customers, $180k ARR, 15% MoM growth over the last
four months. One pilot converted to a full-site rollout last week.

Team: Two ex-Amazon robotics engineers. Technical co-founder built the
vision stack at Zoox before it was acquired.

Risks: Hardware is single-sourced from one vendor in Taiwan right now.
No enterprise sales hire yet - founder has been running sales personally.

Notes: Founder got noticeably defensive when asked about pilot churn.
Ask for cohort-level retention data before the next call, not just
headline ARR.
